name: web-catalog-listing-page-with-category-tiles-filters-and-product-grid
title: Long catalog listing: category tiles, sidebar filters, four-up product cards and related products, with mobile views
whatItIs: A lavender board '(08) Catalog' with a tall desktop page: header with search and nav, a title with count, a grid of category tiles with photos, a left sidebar of category tree and checkbox filters, a four-column grid of product cards with price and blue cart buttons, pagination and related products; two mobile lists sit at the sides.
whatItMeans: Thorough and practical; repeated cards and clear filters make thousands of items manageable.
techniques: Use category image tiles above the grid.
Repeat product cards with consistent info.

vocabulary.definition: A small image card linking to a subcategory.
A card with photo, name, price and button.
